scope: Full 265-character analysis after The King. Twelve owner-approved kit improvements applied on 2026-11-11; all base stats and artwork preserved. Remaining watch cases are recommendations.

appliedChanges.reason: Owner requested improvements to both Astral Mythicals after a speed- and rarity-focused balance review.

method.bulk: HP × (1 + DEF / 500), neutral direct damage only
method.growth: Current level, ascension and two Limit Break rules; Commons have no Limit Break
limits: Damage per tile is not a universal power score or a win-rate estimate.
Healing/Regeneration/Barrier/DoT figures are capacities, not guaranteed realized value; no additive overall score.
No board, enemy countdown, counterattack trigger, recovery, Dispel/Cleanse opportunity or random targeting is simulated in cast fixtures. Those are inspected from actual rules and kit data.
No claim that every Legendary must win every specialized comparison against every Rare. Higher rarity should provide a clear overall premium within a comparable role.
Faction cost figures isolate matching-mana effects; opening Nether mana applies once. Other faction strengths are evaluated separately.

1.text: Each Goblin has a 70% chance to block an incoming Mana Slow or Mana Block application. Personal protection; active from one member and does not stack.

2.text: +10% ATK for Djedi members. Requires 2+ members; the bonus stays at 10% with additional members.

1.text: Arcane Resonance: +5% mana generation for all allies, including Magic champions. Stacks by 5% per Magic champion.

2.text: Arcane Resonance: +10% mana generation for all allies, including Magic champions. Stacks by 5% per Magic champion.

3.text: Arcane Resonance: +15% mana generation for all allies, including Magic champions. Stacks by 5% per Magic champion.

4.text: Arcane Resonance: +20% mana generation for all allies, including Magic champions. Stacks by 5% per Magic champion.

5.text: Arcane Resonance: +25% mana generation for all allies, including Magic champions. Stacks by 5% per Magic champion.

2.text: Tailwind Guard: +4% DEF and +5% mana from matching runes.

3.text: Tailwind Guard: +6% DEF and +10% mana from matching runes.

2.text: 50% chance for each Special ailment applied to an enemy to last 1 extra turn.

3.text: Special ailments applied to enemies last 1 extra turn.

2.text: At battle start: each member has a 50% chance to gain 10% of their own maximum mana.

3.text: At battle start: each member gains 15% of their own maximum mana.

2.text: Each member rolls separately each turn: 10% chance to gain 2% ATK, DEF and max HP. Stacks.

3.text: Each member rolls separately each turn: 15% chance to gain 2% ATK, DEF and max HP. Stacks.
Recover 4% max HP each turn; start with +5% max HP.

recommendations.name: Sister Carmine
recommendations.note: 32% instant team healing plus 30% further Regeneration and Attack Up at ten tiles exceeds many Legendary support kits. Bloodcourt adds innate sustain. If trimmed, reduce one healing component/duration modestly, then buff weak higher-tier identities.

recommendations.name: Azhar, the Rosetted Sun
recommendations.note: Very Fast AoE with self Attack Up, enemy Defense Down and Buff Seal. Same effect package as Hadrian at 6.5 versus 10 tiles; about 23% more neutral damage per tile before faction mana. Three Veldtborn reduce the matching requirement to 5. Review this interaction before adding similar kits.

recommendations.name: Varya, the Stormbound Circuit
recommendations.note: Full-charge 260% plus Dispel/Mana Slow costs 10, while Sora casts at 8 with a stronger actual hit through Vulnerability and Dispel. Mana Slow immunity is useful but does not fill the gap. Improve the full-charge utility/payoff while retaining early choice.

recommendations.name: Ixanth, Solar Wing
recommendations.note: The eight-tile 160% tier has no utility and loses neutral burst to Rare Scavenger Jax. Full-charge damage is almost identical to Rare Shade Prince at the same ten tiles; Dispel and better stats help, but the Legendary kit needs a clearer premium.

implementedAdditions.name: The King
implementedAdditions.gap: Factionless warrior king with the highest baseline Attack and a 25% chance to dodge damaging Specials.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Frost-blood duelist: a focused Dispel/anti-Barrier striker, not another healing engine.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Blue currently has only Lysandre, a charging Legendary attacker; this adds a different fast tactical option.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Aurora thorn hunter: focused damage and short Buff Seal, balanced for fast access.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: The only Green Frost member is Common Beastmaster Gharn.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Eclipse-frost hunter: a distinct focused finisher, with utility kept narrow.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: The only Blue Umbra member is Common Hooded Thrall; all three current Umbra Rares are Purple.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Dusk-flower cleanser: modest team healing and Cleanse, without adding more passive regeneration.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Purple has just one Wildgrove member, Velis; the entire roster has only one Purple Rare support.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Amethyst scale sentinel: brief Taunt and Ward with a deliberate defensive identity.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Purple currently has only Lady Death; Dragon Dynasty has only two defenders and three Rares.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Mirage-tide raider: a fast sniper with a small focused debuff.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: The only Blue Dune Rider is Mythical Nayara, so this element is inaccessible without a Mythical pull.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Cinder-chimera skirmisher: focused damage and one short ailment; budget around guaranteed faction extension.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Red currently has only slow Legendary Kaitha. Chymera has seven attackers versus nine non-attackers.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Void foundry siege-caster: a distinct area attacker with limited control, not a Torvek sniper copy.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Purple currently has only Torvek. This adds AoE variety without another defender to a defense-heavy faction.

historicalAdditionSlots.niche: Verdigris oathkeeper: ally protection or a team Barrier, without duplicating Aurel’s revival.
historicalAdditionSlots.gap: Green currently has only Valcera; the whole roster has only one Green Legendary defender, Kelydras.

passive.name: Unclosing Wound
passive.desc: On turns 5, 10, 15 and every fifth board turn thereafter, Yshmir deals damage equal to 20% of one random living enemy's maximum HP. Triggers only while Yshmir is alive.

review.note: Preserve the explicitly requested Very Slow speed and random 20%-max-HP strike every fifth turn. Its value rises with enemy HP and fight length; evaluate bosses separately. It is not comparable to ordinary ATK-scaled burst.
Keep Slow 12; extend Taunt and self Damage Ward from 1 to 2 turns. Retain the 176% hit and Attack Down 3. Owner-approved 2026-11-11; now implemented.
